Name: DoorstepGifts
Author: Zexu2K
Description:
[center][color=#ff7700][size=6]Doorstep Gifts[/size][/color][/center]
[center][size=4][b]Doorstep Gifts[/b] adds a simple, thoughtful way to give presents without interrupting a villager’s routine. No knocking, instant deliveries, or changes to NPC schedules — just a gift waiting for the right person.[/size][/center]

[heading]How It Works[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Hold the item you want to give.[/*]
[*]Interact with a supported bedroom door and select [b]Leave a Gift[/b].[/*]
[*]If the room has multiple residents, choose your recipient.[/*]
[*]A wrapped present appears on the ground.[/*]
[*]Your chosen villager collects it when they physically walk over it and can accept another gift.[/*]
[/list][b]Doors can be locked, unlocked, or open.[/b] You don’t need access to the room to leave a present.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Gifts for a specific recipient.[/b] Other villagers can walk over the package without taking it.[/*]
[*][b]Shared rooms supported.[/b] Choose exactly who the present is for.[/*]
[*][b]Vanilla gift mechanics.[/b] Gift tastes, quality, birthdays, friendship gains, and standard gift limits use the game’s existing system.[/*]
[*][b]Reaction notifications.[/b] Find out whether your recipient loved, liked, disliked, hated, or felt neutral about your gift.[/*]
[*][b]Persistent presents.[/b] Waiting gifts remain through normal saves and reloads.[/*]
[*][b]Gift retrieval.[/b] Change your mind? Retrieve your present before it is collected. Only its owner can retrieve it.[/*]
[*][b]Custom door definitions.[/b] Content Packs can add support for additional rooms and residents.[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu integration.[/b][/*]
[*][b]English and Polish translations.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer support.[/b][/*]
[/list][heading]A Gift Worth Waiting For[/heading]
Leaving a package does not immediately award friendship points or use a gift slot. It counts when the recipient collects it.
If their daily or weekly limit is already reached, the gift stays where it is. They can collect it during a later eligible passage — perhaps tomorrow, or after the weekly limit resets.
By default, each door allows up to [b]four waiting packages[/b], with [b]one waiting gift per recipient at that door[/b].

[heading]Recovery Command[/heading]
[code]doorstep_gifts[/code]in the SMAPI console to open your gift recovery menu, including waiting gifts on locations that have changed or been removed.

Manifest.Name: Doorstep Gifts
Manifest.Description: Leave persistent, recipient-bound gifts at private doors for NPCs to collect while walking.
